# env/components-creds.example.txt — infra-creds template for 05-search (### NN_Service format).
#
# REAL secrets go in env/components-creds.txt (GITIGNORED) — never in this committed
# .example file. Workflow:
#   cp env/components-creds.example.txt env/components-creds.txt
#   $EDITOR env/components-creds.txt        # paste the FULL ### infra dump (all blocks)
#   chmod 600 env/components-creds.txt
#   # verify-only: paste 01-auth's JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 + INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN into the
#   # ### Auth_Identity block below (from 01-auth's rendered env/.env.dev), then:
#   ./env/init-env.sh .env.dev             # renders env/.env.dev
#
# init-env.sh reads env/components-creds.txt (gitignored). Paste the FULL infra status
# dump (all ### blocks); 05-search uses only these infra blocks:
#   01_PostgreSQL 02_MongoDB 03_Elasticsearch 05_Kafka 07_Elastic_APM.
# ES-port rule: the application LOG SINK ES is the APM-stack ES (block 07, :9200 —
# the `elasticsearch` line + `elastic-pass`). Block 03_Elasticsearch (:9201) is the
# SEPARATE business-search store (dokandar-products/-shops) — 05-search + 08-review only.
#
# 05-search is VERIFY-ONLY (admin reindex route verifies JWTs with auth's PUBLIC key
# + the shared east-west token). It NEVER generates a keypair — paste both values into
# the ### Auth_Identity block (or rely on the AUTH_ENV_FILE fallback).

### 01_PostgreSQL
   host:port      <host>:5432
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 02_MongoDB
   endpoint       mongodb://<user>:<password>@<host>:27017/?authSource=admin

### 03_Elasticsearch
   host:port      <host>:9201
   user           <user>
   password       <password>

### 05_Kafka
   bootstrap      <host>:9092

### 07_Elastic_APM
   elasticsearch  http://elastic:<elastic-pass>@<host>:9200
   apm-ingest     http://<host>:8200
   apm-token      <apm-bearer-token>
   elastic-pass   <elastic-pass>

### Auth_Identity
   auth_service_public_key   <paste 01-auth .env.dev JWT_PUBLIC_KEY_B64>
   internal_service_token    <paste 01-auth .env.dev INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN>
